university.name: Coventry University
university.summary: Coventry University is based in Coventry and has an international students hub covering entry requirements, fees and scholarships. It teaches undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses, with several start dates across the year. Its international entry requirements page currently states that recruitment from Pakistan is paused.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of student sponsors, file dated 2026-10-07, Student route)

courses.title: Computer Science MSc
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, or up to 2 years full-time with professional placement
courses.tuition_academic_year: Not labelled on the page; applies to the first academic year of study (page lists 2026-27 and 2027-28 entry)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in computer science for graduates of a computational discipline with programming experience. Compulsory modules cover advanced programming, software development, secure systems and machine learning, with an individual research project and an optional professional placement.
courses.academic_requirements: An honours degree 2:2 or above (or international equivalent) in a computational discipline. Knowledge and experience of programming are essential.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with no component lower than 5.5. A pre-sessional English programme is an alternative. Other approved tests are listed on a separate university page.
courses.experience_requirements: Knowledge and experience of programming are essential.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The international entry requirements page states 'Recruitment is currently paused' under Pakistan and lists no Pakistan thresholds.
courses.notes: Page lists start dates September 2026 and November 2026 to July 2027 for 2026-27 entry, and lists 2027-28 as a year of entry without dates; no September 2027 start is shown. Fee is the international figure of GBP 19,500 per year, plus a GBP 1,900 placement fee if a placement is secured; the table is not dated. Recruitment from Pakistan is stated as paused on the university's international entry requirements page.

courses.title: Data Science and Computational Intelligence MSc
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, or up to 2 years full-time with professional placement
courses.tuition_academic_year: Not labelled on the page; applies to the first academic year of study (page lists 2026-27 and 2027-28 entry)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in data science for graduates in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering or similar subjects. Modules cover machine learning, deep learning and computer vision, professional practice and generative AI, with an individual research project and optional placement.
courses.academic_requirements: An honours degree at 2:2 or above (or international equivalent) in a relevant discipline such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or engineering.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component. A pre-sessional English programme is an alternative. Other approved tests are listed on a separate university page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The international entry requirements page states 'Recruitment is currently paused' under Pakistan and lists no Pakistan thresholds.
courses.notes: Page lists start dates November 2026 to July 2027 for 2026-27 entry and 2027-28 as a year of entry without dates; no September 2027 start is shown. Fee GBP 19,500 plus GBP 1,900 placement fee if a placement is secured; the table is not dated. The page labels the individual research project both compulsory and optional in different places. Recruitment from Pakistan is stated as paused.

courses.title: International Business Management MSc
courses.tuition_academic_year: Not labelled on the page; applies to the first academic year of study (page lists 2026-27 and 2027-28 entry)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time conversion master's open to graduates of any discipline, or to applicants with relevant work experience and professional qualifications. All modules are compulsory and cover international strategy, leadership, supply chains and finance, plus a postgraduate project.
highlights: Global Business Environment and International Business Strategy
People, Relationships and Leadership in Practice
International Supply Chain Management and Operations Strategy
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree 2:2 or above (or international equivalent) in any discipline, or demonstrable and appropriate work experience together with relevant professional qualifications.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with no component lower than 5.5. A pre-sessional English programme is an alternative. Other approved tests are listed on a separate university page.
courses.experience_requirements: Work experience with relevant professional qualifications is accepted as an alternative to a degree.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The international entry requirements page states 'Recruitment is currently paused' under Pakistan and lists no Pakistan thresholds.
courses.notes: Page lists start dates November 2026 to July 2027 for 2026-27 entry and 2027-28 as a year of entry without dates; no September 2027 start is shown. The fee table is not dated, and deferring may lead to a higher fee. Recruitment from Pakistan is stated as paused.

courses.title: Finance MSc
courses.tuition_academic_year: Not labelled on the page; applies to the first academic year of study (page lists 2026-27 and 2027-28 entry)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in finance open to graduates of any discipline, or to applicants with finance sector experience and professional qualifications. All modules are compulsory and cover capital markets, corporate finance and risk, data analysis and a postgraduate project.
courses.academic_requirements: An honours degree 2:2 or above in any discipline, or appropriate work experience in the financial sector together with relevant professional qualifications.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 6 in each component. A pre-sessional English programme is an alternative. Other approved tests are listed on a separate university page.
courses.experience_requirements: Financial sector work experience with professional qualifications is accepted as an alternative to a degree.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The international entry requirements page states 'Recruitment is currently paused' under Pakistan and lists no Pakistan thresholds.
courses.notes: Page lists start dates November 2026 to July 2027 for 2026-27 entry and 2027-28 as a year of entry without dates; no September 2027 start is shown. The fee table is not dated. Recruitment from Pakistan is stated as paused.

scholarships.name: Coventry University Group Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 per year of study deducted from tuition fees (published for 2026/27)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for self-funded international students (excluding the UK and EU) enrolling on taught full-time bachelor's or master's degrees at eligible UK Coventry University Group campuses. There is no separate application; the deposit must be cleared by the offer letter date.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded, paying overseas fees, fully enrolled for 2026/27 at an eligible UK campus, full CAS deposit cleared by the date in the offer letter. Not for 100% online courses or Wrocław. Pathways students receive it in the first year only.
scholarships.deadline_note: No calendar date; CAS deposit must be cleared by the date in the offer letter. Published for 2026/27 only; 2027/28 terms not found.
scholarships.notes: The main scholarships page lists the award as 2026-27 only and not for 2027 entry. The university states recruitment from Pakistan is paused, so Pakistani applicants should confirm they can apply before relying on this award. Can be combined with Sport Scholarships only.
